title: invoice.coupon_apply
description: Applying a coupon to a customer (BE-IV-18): copied values and overrides, the active-coupon, limitation-overlap and reusability checks, and the customer currency. Errors are domain errors; when several apply, the first in this order is reported: inactive coupon (`coupon_not_found`), limitation overlap (`plan_overlapping`), reusability (`coupon_is_not_reusable` on `coupon`), then the value checks of the applied coupon in the order amount_cents, amount_currency, frequency_duration.

plans.description: Plans with the billable metrics their charges use (plans named only in limitations exist without charges).

applied_before.description: The customer's earlier applied coupons: of another coupon when `coupon` is given, else of the coupon being applied. An entry without `coupon` is an applied coupon of that same catalogue coupon, with its targets and its own values: it counts for the reusability check and, while active and the coupon is limited, for the overlap check (BE-IV-18).

overrides.description: Values given in the apply request; every value not given is the coupon's own (a `frequency` override without `frequency_duration` takes the coupon's duration, BE-IV-18).
